Proposition
[Projection is distance nonincreasing] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0437 ↗ lem:chow-iii-h8-projection-inequality 1. apph:H.9\group Euclidean convexity

For a closed convex $K\subset \R ^n$, \[ |\pi _K(x)-\pi _K(y)|\le |x-y|. \]
Proof

\sketch Apply the projection inequality twice and add the resulting inequalities.
